GameDBLocalizedString.Text: Once they are blessed by the Primal's blast stone and inhabited by the swarm, the Askons begin to form their tumors. The perfect host for any hunter-warrior who does not prefer the way of claws and teeth.

Brutal monsters, perfected by the parasitic swarm. It is said that the mind of the beast can't be completely subdued. It slowly blends with the swarm's consciousness, which becomes addicted to the most gory ways of fighting.

The tribes from swamp territories are using the flying hosts to collect the treasures of starship wreckages hidden behind the impenetrable fog and murky waters. Even implanting parts of machines into their own bodies.

The time of the Raughirs is almost over. The ancient genetic matrices are wearing off and most offspring are being born deformed or untamable. However, each successful attempt will overshadow dozens of previous failures.
